items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember any of the songs that went with some of the dances like the Bambuma or the Kalinda or the Kungjain? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Don't say Kalinda.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the songs that went with some of the dances like the Bambuma or the Kalinda or the Kungjain?
Oui, you can you sing a little about that? Don't say Kalinda, Bujun, Bujun. Mr. Pila or Cops. I'm going to hear something. I'm going to hear something.
